title: The routing guard counts finished agents as running
what: The routing guard's "agents are already running" count matches what is really running in the session: an agent that ended without a stop event in the ledger (a workflow agent that died, crashed or ended without its structured output) stops counting once it has ended.
why: 26 Oct evening, measured: after workflow wami2lmn7 ended (15 agents, one of them ended without StructuredOutput), starting one fixer got "Routing note: 7 agents are already running in this session (cap 6)", while ListAgents at the same moment showed 1 running subagent and one workflow with one agent. running_now counts relay_ledger.running_agents over the last 12 h. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: A ledger for one session with 7 agent-start events from a workflow that ended and no matching stop events, and 1 live agent: running_now reports 7 or 8 instead of 1.
pass_cases: The same ledger with stop events reports only the live agent; a session with 2 live agents reports 2; a cap warning still fires at the cap when the agents really run.
